description: List short lessons from Patch fixes merged in your projects: what was fixed, in which pull request, whether yof's next check confirmed it, and how to avoid it next time. Use it before writing similar code so the same problem does not come back; use yof_patch_status for pull requests still open. Needs YOF_API_KEY; sends only app_id to yof.io, which answers from stored data (up to 50 merged pull requests, most recently opened first). Returns lessons (repository, pull_request, merged, rule, note, avoid_next_time); an empty list means no Patch fix has been merged yet.

app_id.description: One app's id, to list only that app's lessons. Default: every app in the account.

name: yof_lessons

note.description: What was fixed and whether the next check confirmed it.

title: Lessons from merged fixes
